title: Add this boarding pass to your wallet
scenario: An email says your mobile boarding pass has been “reissued” after a seat change. The attachment asks you to install a wallet profile and sign in again to retrieve the new QR code.

answers.A: Open the airline app or official site and regenerate the boarding pass from your booking.
answers.B: Check the seat change with the airline before installing any profile or signing in through the attachment.
answers.C: Install the wallet item but stop if it asks for permissions beyond notifications.

explanation: Boarding passes are easy to regenerate through the airline. There is no reason to trust an unsolicited profile or login flow.
proTip: If an app can generate it, let the app generate it.
